title: A batch runner says so when a handed-over lane is left out of a batch
why: Coordinator 11:45 CST Nov 8: degen #438's handed-lane check, filed here. A runner can drop a lane that was handed to it with no word to the lane or the coordinator; this is the same gap as the earlier finding that runners drop lanes without a word. Fix: a check that each lane PR handed to the runner is in the batch, or named as left out with a reason.
